response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_price, avg_per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) FROM per_rating) AS ratio_to_rating_mean FROM per_rating ORDER BY rating;

assumptions.assumption: The SQL is MySQL 8 syntax, matching the Sakila-style schema. Each film's per-day price is rental_rate / rental_duration at the film level, averaged within each rating. The denominator is the simple mean of the five per-rating per-day averages, so each rating counts once. No ROUND is applied. The verified data shows rental_duration is never zero, so the division is safe.
